title: Power-generated ring maps induce universal homeomorphisms
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $p$ be a prime integer. Suppose $\ker\varphi$ consists of nilpotent elements and $B$ is generated as an $R$-algebra by elements $x$ each satisfying $x^{p^n}\in\varphi(R)$ and $p^n x\in\varphi(R)$ for some integer $n>0$ depending on $x$. Then $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. More explicitly, for every commutative $R$-algebra $R\prime$ the map $R\prime\to R\prime\otimes_R B$ satisfies the same two hypotheses (with the same prime $p$) and induces a homeomorphism on prime spectra.
